methodology.unit: 15 fixed equation families measured repeatedly at five seeds
methodology.interpretation: seeds are repeated measurements, not independent equation families
methodology.inferential_tests: none across seeds; descriptive mean and sample SD only
methodology.failed_or_nonfinite_primary_evaluations: preserved as null and excluded from metric means
methodology.llm_contrast: hypatia_vs_nollm is the incremental LLM-enabled Hybrid contrast, not standalone Pure LLM
